# Pull request

## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change proposed.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant automated checks pass.
- [ ] Manual validation is described below.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated when needed.
- [ ] No credentials, private data or generated secrets are included.

## Security impact

Describe any change to permissions, authentication, secrets, external requests,
data retention or write operations. Write `None` when not applicable.
